season.sr: Otvoren svakog dana, svih 365 dana u godini.
season.en: Open every day, all year round.

tagline.sr: Jedan od najboljih zooloških vrtova na svetu, na pola sata od centra Praga.
tagline.en: One of the world's best zoos, half an hour from central Prague.

description.sr: Zoološki vrt u Pragu redovno se svrstava među najbolje na svetu. Prostire se preko 58 hektara uz reku Vltavu, sa prostranim ograđenim prostorima poput Doline slonova i paviljona gorila. Staze su široke i popločane, pa se kroz njega lagano ide s kolicima, a usput su česta dečja igrališta i toaleti s prostorom za presvlačenje.
description.en: Prague Zoo is regularly ranked among the world's best. It spreads over 58 hectares along the Vltava river, with huge enclosures like the elephant valley and the gorilla pavilion. Paths are wide and paved, so it is easy with a pushchair, and playgrounds and baby-change facilities are dotted along the way.

highlights.en: The elephant valley and gorilla pavilion
The chairlift ride over the enclosures
Children's playgrounds scattered through the park
Scheduled animal feedings

pros.sr: Odlično prilagođen kolicima – široke popločane staze
pros.en: Very pushchair-friendly – wide paved paths

pros.sr: Ogroman izbor životinja za jedan dan
pros.en: A huge variety of animals for a full day

pros.sr: Deca do 3 godine ulaze besplatno
pros.en: Children under 3 enter free

cons.sr: Vikendom i leti zna da bude gužva
cons.en: Can get crowded on weekends and in summer

cons.sr: Teren je brežuljkast na pojedinim delovima
cons.en: The terrain is hilly in some parts

tip.sr: Kupite karte online – jeftinije su, a preskačete red na blagajni.
tip.en: Buy tickets online – they are cheaper and you skip the ticket-office queue.

season.sr: Vodeni trikovi i dvorac rade od kraja marta do početka novembra; zimi je zatvoreno.
season.en: The trick fountains and palace run from late March to early November; closed in winter.

tagline.sr: Renesansni dvorac gde vas fontane namerno prskaju – deca se smeju od početka do kraja.
tagline.en: A Renaissance palace where the fountains deliberately spray you – children laugh the whole way round.

description.sr: Helbrun je dvorac nadomak Salcburga čuven po starim vodenim trikovima: skrivene mlaznice prskaju posetioce dok šetaju vrtom. Za malu decu je to urnebesna predstava – voda, figure koje se pokreću i smeh na svakom koraku. Tu je i prostrani park s igralištem, a odmah pored je salcburški ZOO vrt.
description.en: Hellbrunn is a palace just outside Salzburg famous for its 400-year-old trick fountains: hidden jets spray visitors as they wander the gardens. For small children it is a hilarious show – water, moving figures and laughter at every turn. There is also a large park with a playground, and Salzburg Zoo is right next door.

highlights.en: The trick fountains (Wasserspiele)
The playground in the park

highlights.sr: Sjenica iz filma Moje pesme, moji snovi
highlights.en: The gazebo from The Sound of Music
Salzburg Zoo right next door

pros.sr: Vodeni trikovi su čista zabava za najmlađe
pros.en: The trick fountains are pure fun for the youngest

pros.sr: Ravna šetnja kroz park pogodna za kolica
pros.en: Flat park paths suitable for a pushchair

pros.sr: Deca do 4 godine ulaze besplatno
pros.en: Children under 4 enter free

cons.sr: Zatvoreno zimi (od novembra do marta)
cons.en: Closed in winter (November to March)

cons.sr: Trikovi vas namerno pokvase – ponesite presvlaku
cons.en: The tricks deliberately soak you – bring a change of clothes

cons.sr: Obično se ide u vođenoj grupi, pa je tempo zadat
cons.en: Tours are usually guided, so the pace is set

tip.en: Bring spare clothes and shoes – getting splashed is the whole point.

tagline.sr: Najposećeniji muzej Švajcarske – gde deca ulaze u vozove, avione i čamce.
tagline.en: Switzerland's most-visited museum – where children climb into trains, planes and boats.

description.sr: Muzej saobraćaja u Lucernu najposećeniji je muzej Švajcarske i raj za decu koja vole vozove, avione i čamce. Mališani mogu da se popnu u prave lokomotive i avione, da voze po saobraćajnom vrtu s mini putevima, i da pogledaju planetarijum. Za uzrast od dve godine nadalje gotovo svaka zona ima nešto za njih.
description.en: Lucerne's Museum of Transport is Switzerland's most-visited museum and a paradise for children who love trains, planes and boats. Little ones can climb into real locomotives and aircraft, ride mini roads in the traffic garden, and watch the planetarium. From about age two, nearly every zone has something for them.

highlights.sr: Ulazak u prave lokomotive i avione
highlights.en: Climbing into real locomotives and aircraft
The traffic garden with mini roads
The Swiss Chocolate Adventure
The planetarium

pros.sr: Interaktivno i praktično – deca sve diraju
pros.en: Interactive and hands-on – children touch everything

season.sr: Oba su otvorena cele godine; NEMO je ponedeljkom često zatvoren van raspusta.
season.en: Both open year-round; NEMO is often closed on Mondays outside school holidays.

tagline.sr: Dva suseda za jedan dan: nauka kroz igru u NEMO, pa životinje u Artisu.
tagline.en: Two neighbours for one day: hands-on science at NEMO, then animals at Artis.

description.sr: NEMO je naučni muzej u zgradi u obliku broda, sa pet spratova eksperimenata koje deca sama pokreću – voda, zvuk, svetlost. Deset minuta hoda dalje je Artis, gradski ZOO vrt s akvarijumom i planetarijumom. Zajedno čine savršen dan u Amsterdamu za decu od 3 do 6 godina, i to bez obzira na vreme.
description.en: NEMO is a science museum in a ship-shaped building, with five floors of experiments children operate themselves – water, sound, light. Ten minutes' walk away is Artis, the city zoo with an aquarium and planetarium. Together they make a perfect Amsterdam day for ages 3–6, whatever the weather.

highlights.en: Water and sound experiments at NEMO

The aquarium at Artis
The playground at Artis

tip.en: Arrive at NEMO as it opens – mornings are far calmer for experimenting.

tagline.sr: Najveća maketa železnice na svetu – gradovi i vozovi koji oduševljavaju i najmlađe.
tagline.en: The world's largest model railway – cities and trains that delight even the youngest.

description.sr: Miniatur Vunderland je najveća maketa železnice na svetu: preko 16 kilometara pruge, gradovi, planine i aerodrom gde avioni poleću i sleću. Deca stoje očarana dok vozovi prolaze, a dan i noć se smenjuju svakih petnaestak minuta. Sve je u zatvorenom, pa je savršen izbor za kišni dan u Hamburgu.
description.en: Miniatur Wunderland is the world's largest model railway: over 16 kilometres of track, cities, mountains and an airport where planes take off and land. Children stand spellbound as trains pass and day turns to night every fifteen minutes or so. Everything is indoors, making it a perfect rainy-day choice in Hamburg.

tagline.sr: Svetska klasa džabe: dinosaurusi, nauka i igra – sve bez ulaznice.
tagline.en: World-class for free: dinosaurs, science and play – all without a ticket.

description.sr: U Londonu su najbolji porodični muzeji besplatni. Prirodnjački muzej čuva dinosauruse i plavog kita Houp, a Muzej nauke ima interaktivne zone za najmlađe. Kad deca požele da se istrče, Dečje igralište princeze Dijane u Kenzington vrtovima ima gusarski brod. Ceo dan može da prođe bez ijedne karte.
description.en: London's best family museums are free. The Natural History Museum holds the dinosaurs and Hope the blue whale, while the Science Museum has interactive zones for the youngest. When children need to run around, the Diana Memorial Playground in Kensington Gardens has a pirate ship. A whole day can pass without a single ticket.

tagline.sr: Šarene fasade i kanali Male Venecije + muzej igračaka za najmlađe.
tagline.en: Colourful facades and Little Venice canals + a toy museum for the youngest.

description.sr: Kolmar izgleda kao iz slikovnice: šarene drvene kuće, kanali i cveće na svakom prozoru. Za decu su najzanimljiviji vožnja čamcem kroz Malu Veneciju, mali voz kroz centar i Muzej igračaka, gde deca do 8 godina ulaze besplatno. Na petnaest minuta vožnje je Sigoland, park roda s blagim vožnjama za uzrast od 2 do 12 godina.
description.en: Colmar looks straight out of a picture book: colourful half-timbered houses, canals and flowers in every window. For children the highlights are a boat ride through Little Venice, the little train through the centre, and the Toy Museum, where under-8s enter free. Fifteen minutes away is Cigoland, a stork park with gentle rides for ages 2–12.

tagline.sr: Norveška kombinacija ZOO vrta i tematskog parka – sa gradom iz bajke Kardemome.
tagline.en: Norway's zoo-and-theme-park combo – with Cardamom Town from the fairy tales.

description.sr: Dirparken je najveća porodična atrakcija Norveške: ZOO vrt sa lavovima i majmunima spojen s tematskim parkom. Zvezda je Kardemoma by – grad iz bajki Turbjerna Egnera – a tu su i blage vožnje baš za mališane. Badeland, vodeni park, doplaćuje se posebno, ali leti vredi svake krune.
description.en: Dyreparken is Norway's biggest family attraction: a zoo with lions and monkeys combined with a theme park. The star is Kardemomme by – Cardamom Town from Thorbjørn Egner's tales – plus gentle rides made for toddlers. Badeland, the water park, costs extra but is worth every krone in summer.

tagline.sr: Jedan od najstarijih ZOO vrtova Evrope + Afrikarijum sa morskim psima i pingvinima.
tagline.en: One of Europe's oldest zoos + the Afrykarium with sharks and penguins.

description.sr: ZOO Vroclav je jedan od najstarijih i najvećih u Evropi, a njegova perjanica je Afrikarijum – moderan okeanarijum s tunelom kroz koji plivaju morski psi i raže. Ulaz u Afrikarijum je uključen u svaku ZOO kartu. Staze su široke i ravne, pa je park veoma pogodan za kolica, uz brojna igrališta.
description.en: Wrocław Zoo is one of Europe's oldest and largest, and its pride is the Afrykarium – a modern oceanarium with a tunnel where sharks and rays swim overhead. Entry to the Afrykarium is included in every zoo ticket. Paths are wide and flat, so the park is very pushchair-friendly, with plenty of playgrounds.

tagline.sr: Alpska jezera i ravne šetnje po pločniku – priroda prilagođena kolicima.
tagline.en: Alpine lakes and flat paved walks – nature that suits a stroller.

description.sr: Štrbske Pleso je najpitomiji kutak Visokih Tatri: glacijalno jezero s ravnom, popločanom stazom oko njega, idealnom za kolica i prve korake. Žičara vodi do Skalnatog plesa gde leti rade igralište i vožnje za decu, a zimi se okolne padine pretvaraju u sankaške staze. Pešačke ture su kratke i bezbedne za porodice.
description.en: Štrbské Pleso is the gentlest corner of the High Tatras: a glacial lake with a flat, paved path around it, ideal for pushchairs and first steps. A cable car rises to Skalnaté pleso, where a playground and children's rides run in summer, while winter turns the slopes into sledging runs. The hikes are short and safe for families.

tagline.sr: Šuma kristala i igralište u vrtu – blještava avantura za male radoznalce.
tagline.en: A crystal forest and garden playground – a sparkling adventure for little explorers.

description.sr: Kristalni svetovi Svarovski u Vatensu su mešavina muzeja, umetnosti i bašte. Ulaz čuva divovska glava s vodopadom, a unutra su odaje ispunjene svetlošću i bojama. Deca najviše uživaju u vrtu s igralištem, lavirintom i kristalnim oblakom iznad vode. Više je za gledanje nego za diranje, ali malim radoznalcima je čarobno.
description.en: Swarovski Crystal Worlds in Wattens mixes museum, art and garden. A giant head with a waterfall guards the entrance, and inside are chambers full of light and colour. Children enjoy the garden most – the playground, maze and crystal cloud above the water. It is more to look at than to touch, but magical for little explorers.

tagline.sr: Pipi, Emil i Karlson uživo – bajke Astrid Lindgren u šumi gde je sve igra.
tagline.en: Pippi, Emil and Karlsson live – Astrid Lindgren's tales in a forest where everything is play.

description.sr: Svet Astrid Lindgren u Vimerbiju oživljava njene bajke u prirodnoj šumi: vila Pipi Duga Čarapa, selo Buleba i Emilov salaš. Sve je u dečjoj visini, sa živim predstavama i prostorima za slobodnu igru. To je miran, zelen park bez vrtoglavih vožnji – savršen za uzrast od 3 do 6 godina i njihove roditelje.
description.en: Astrid Lindgren's World in Vimmerby brings her tales to life in a natural forest: Pippi Longstocking's Villa Villekulla, the Bullerbyn village and Emil's farm. Everything is at child height, with live shows and open play areas. It is a calm, green park with no dizzying rides – perfect for ages 3–6 and their parents.
